label: Outer Collar Stand
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: The grain change is genuinely visible - vertical stripe on the body, diagonal stripe on the collar piece - which is the visual signature of a bias-cut collar component. But the diagonal run is on the top collar / collar leaf; the OUTER COLLAR STAND (the band) is hidden under the folded collar and cannot be independently confirmed as bias cut.

Shows the bias-versus-straight-grain contrast between collar and body, which is the right family, but again the diagonal run is on the collar leaf. The outer collar stand is only glimpsed at the throat and its stripe direction there is not resolvable at this size, so 'bias cut on outer collar stand' is not unambiguously shown.

The collar component clearly runs off-grain relative to the body so it reads as a bias-cut collar, but the band/outer stand is completely covered by the collar fall - no stand seam and no stand stripe direction is visible. Nothing in frame ties the bias specifically to the outer collar stand.
